# PixelToCloud Solutions

> Web and software studio in Alwar, Rajasthan, India (GSTIN 08CSRPA1400M1ZS). We build websites, online stores, custom software and mobile apps, set up WhatsApp automation and AI chatbots, and handle SEO, Google Business Profile, social media, ads, logo design, videos and digital wedding invitations for businesses in all of India and abroad. Fixed written quotes, websites launched in 7 days, and the client owns the website and domain.

Contact: WhatsApp or call +91 82193 52124, email contact@pixeltocloud.com. Hours: Monday to Sunday, 9 am to 7 pm IST. Address: Ram Mandir, 30 Beegha, Shalimar, Alwar, Rajasthan 301001, India.

## Website packages (one-time)

- Starter: ₹9,999 in India, $299 outside India. A one-page site that gets you found and contacted.
- Business: ₹19,999 in India, $699 outside India. A full site built to rank on Google and be quoted by AI assistants.
- Growth: ₹34,999 in India, $1199 outside India. Business, plus pages and campaigns that bring in new enquiries.

## Monthly plans

- Website care: ₹1,499 a month. Hosting, backups, security updates and up to one hour of small changes every month.
- Google growth: ₹2,499 a month. Weekly Google posts, photo updates, a review-request QR card and a monthly report.
- Social media: ₹6,999 a month. 12 posts and 4 reels a month for Instagram and Facebook, approved by you before they go live.
- WhatsApp assistant: ₹1,999 a month. Running cost for your WhatsApp bot after setup: hosting, replies, reminders and monthly tuning. WhatsApp’s own message charges are billed at cost.

## Software we have built

- [PharmaOS](https://pixeltocloud.com/work/pharmaos/): Pharmacy billing and stock software. Billing, purchases, returns, stock and expiry alerts for a medical shop, running on the shop’s own computer with no monthly fee. Status: Private build, demo on request.
- [AccreditOS](https://pixeltocloud.com/work/accreditos/): College accreditation workspace. Keeps NAAC and NBA work in one place for a college: course outcomes, marks, attainment, evidence files and tasks. Status: Working demo with sample college data.
- [GrowthOS](https://pixeltocloud.com/work/growthos/): Marketing planning and publishing platform. Plans a month of posts with AI, gets each one approved and puts it on a calendar for Instagram, Facebook and Google. Status: Our own platform, used in our marketing service.
